title: Fast-conducting mechanonociceptors uniquely engage reflexive and affective pain circuitry to drive protective responses
title_zh: 快速传导的机械伤害感受器特异性驱动反射与情感性疼痛回路以产生保护性反应
abstract: Nociceptors detect damaging stimuli and evoke pain in healthy animals. We conducted an optogenetic activation screen to identify genetically defined nociceptor populations that elicit place aversion and nocifensive behaviors in response to stimulation. Smr2Cre- and Bmpr1bCre-labeled Aδ high-threshold mechanoreceptors (HTMRs) emerged as two of the few nociceptor populations, and we focused on investigating their physiological, morphological, functional, and synaptic properties. These neurons densely innervate skin and other organs, are activated only by intense, potentially damaging stimuli, and are necessary for protective responses to sharp mechanical stimuli. Centrally, Aδ-HTMR projections span multiple spinal segments and terminate across spinal cord laminae, forming strong, monosynaptic connections onto anterolateral tract projection neurons, including antenna cells of the deep dorsal horn. Aδ-HTMRs also engage a local spinal reflex circuit, enabling a remarkably rapid limb withdrawal. Thus, Aδ-HTMRs are myelinated nociceptors with unique properties that can be exploited for the development of new analgesics.
abstract_zh: 伤害感受器检测损伤性刺激并在健康动物中引发疼痛。我们进行了光遗传激活筛查，以鉴定在刺激时诱导位置厌恶和防御性疼痛行为的遗传定义伤害感受器群。Smr2Cre 与 Bmpr1bCre 标记的 Aδ 高阈机械受体（HTMRs）是少数出现该效应的两类伤害感受器之一，我们随后重点研究其生理、形态、功能及突触特征。这些神经元密集支配皮肤及其他器官，只对强烈且可能致损伤的刺激激活，并对锐利机械刺激的保护性反应必不可少。中枢上，Aδ-HTMR 投射跨越多个脊髓分节并终止于不同脊髓层板，形成对前外侧束投射神经元（包括深背角的 antenna 细胞）的强烈单突触连接。Aδ-HTMR 还招募局部脊髓反射通路，实现异常快速的肢体撤离。因此，Aδ-HTMR 是具有独特特性的有髓化伤害感受器，可用于开发新型镇痛药。
